sources.citation: Berthelette, John. 2002 [ms. 2001]. Sociolinguistic survey report for the Vigué (Viemo) language. SIL Electronic Survey Reports 2002-009. Dallas: SIL International. 21 pp.
sources.note: Nothing on phonology, tone or stress; sociolinguistic survey plus a 232-item French–Viemo wordlist (legacy IPA font). §1.9 p.8: 'We do not know of any past in-depth linguistic work on the Viemo language. André Prost, however, has written two articles about the Viyewo (Prost 1973, 1979).'
